display_name: The Ten Thousand Martyrs of Antioch

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Δέκα Χιλιάδες Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off. The company is named on the calendar as a company by its number alone; the place is added to the display name from the page's own first sentence and not from the calendar's line.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Δέκα Χιλιάδες Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The company names nobody**, so it is one folder and not ten thousand. The page notes an absence and two presences: «Η μνήμη των Αγίων δεν αναφέρεται στον Συναξαριστή του Αγίου Νικόδημου, αναγράφεται όμως σ' αυτόν του Delehaye και στον υπ' αριθ. 53 Κώδικα των Βλατέων» — not in Nikodemos's synaxarion, but written in Delehaye's and in Codex 53 of Vlatades. That is a positive attestation with a noted gap and not a refusal to vouch for the entry. **No `dates` are entered although Decius is named**, because the page gives no year and the reign is not quoted with years on this page; that they are men is the calendar's grammatical gender and nothing more. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
